system.name: EEGSDE
system.one_liner: Controllable 3D molecule generation: the reverse diffusion SDE is steered at every step by the gradient of a rotation-invariant energy that takes a condition.

content.variant_note: five molecule renders from z_T to z_0 as one generation run, an invariance diagram and a condition box above, the guided SDE below
content.argues: A property-conditioned energy that is invariant to rotation guides each reverse-SDE step; its gradient is equivariant, so generated molecules keep rotation invariance.
content.subject: A reverse diffusion trajectory of one 3D molecule, guided at each step by an invariant energy fed with a condition (target structure or quantum properties).

new_tags.name: invariance-pair
new_tags.what: the same sample drawn before and after a transformation (rotation, shift) fed to the same module, with an equality of the two outputs written beneath

lessons.what_to_learn: Show invariance by feeding the same sample before and after a transformation to the same module and writing the equality of the outputs under it; show guidance by one saturated bus line that drops an arrow on each step of the sample chain, with the governing equation under the chain and a brace naming its guidance term.
lessons.suits: Controllable-generation or equivariant methods whose message is that one extra term steers every step of a sampling chain.

evidence: EEGSDE iteratively generates molecules with desired properties (represented by the condition c)
As the energy function is invariant to rotational transformation R, its gradient (i.e., the energy guidance) is equivariant to R

summary: EEGSDE is a framework for controllable 3D molecule generation: the reverse SDE of a diffusion model is steered at every step by the gradient of an energy function that takes a condition c, either a target structure given as a fingerprint or quantum properties such as polarizability, dipole moment and heat capacity. Figure 1 has three bands. On top, a dashed box shows one molecule and its rotated copy fed to the same energy E with E(z,c,t) = E(Rz,c,t) written beneath, beside a dashed box listing the conditions. In the middle, five black tiles with ball-and-stick renders run from the noisy z_T to a clean molecule z_0, and cyan arrows from the Invariant Energy box land on each step. At the bottom the guided SDE is printed with a brace naming the Equivariant Energy Guidance term.
summary_zh: EEGSDE 用对旋转不变的能量函数的梯度逐步引导扩散模型的逆向 SDE，生成满足条件的 3D 分子。上方用旋转前后的同一分子说明能量不变，并列出条件；中间五张分子图从 z_T 走到 z_0，青色箭头逐步引导；下方是引导 SDE 公式。
notes: Prior labels said panels=3; I count two framed panels because the bottom formula row is not framed. The equation strips and the glyphs E and C are placed as small bitmaps, not live text. Fonts and colours (Calibri, Cambria Math, Office theme palette) suggest the figure was drawn in PowerPoint. Whether the five molecule renders are real model samples or illustrative cannot be told from the figure.
